mode.name: Battle Royale
mode.description: Loot, stay in the zone, be the last one standing

markers.label: Landing spot
markers.description: Where people can land when they drop in (spread over the map, on open ground). Without any, they land on the respawn points.

components.note: The zone (radius covers the map). Without one, a zone goes round the middle of the spawns.
Its stages (radius:warn:shrink:damage ...). Without one, five stages.
Spawns spread over the map, far apart (also where bots land).
Crates (tier 1-3) in buildings and cover; more than 32 goes past what bots can track.
Open ground for supply drops during the game.

notes: A big outdoor map with spread-out cover and buildings; a high sky for the drop-in (3000 units is used if there's room). Put the zone's middle where fights should end. A nav mesh is needed. A zone radius of 4000 or more makes games longer (about 6-8 min with 20 players).
